verdict: No concrete correctness blocker found in the tiny test composition. Packed q/k/v gradient assembly and the two independent cross-chunk state adjoints are correct in reviewed cases.

validation.independent_oracle: Scalar time-index conv/SiLU from previously independently reviewed probe, followed by independent per-head exp(g)*(I-beta*k*kT) state projector. Manual packed-channel splitting, no implementation conv/GDN helper in oracle. Central differences cover x, convolution weights, raw history, recurrent initial state, g and beta.
validation.fixtures: B1/B2, T3/T7/T8, K4/K8, one key head/two value heads with dimensions2; nonzero terminal cotangents for both states plus late-only output loss. Chunk cuts1/2 are shorter than convolution history.

test_contract_review: Author forward applies depthwise conv+SiLU before transposing B,C,T to B,T,C, splitting contiguous q/k/v and invoking FP64 recurrence.

Author backward concatenates per-input q/k/v adjoints in the same packed order and transposes back before applying convolution VJP. Repeated-head q/k reduction belongs to and is performed within the independently reviewed GDN adjoint.
Chunk composition carries both cb.history and rb.initial_state into the prefix backward pass, and adds shared convolution weight gradients. Late loss produces nonzero early input gradients.

Author directional tests cover six actual inputs; independent probe adds an alternate mathematical forward, nonzero terminal losses, all six chunk-gradient comparisons, explicit final states and independently detached-path negative controls.
coverage_limits: The two author tests use one seed, one head geometry and zero terminal-state losses. They establish useful composition checks, not comprehensive numerical qualification. Independent probes broaden those specific gaps but retain the same small head geometry.

This is test-local FP64 helper composition, not a production complete GDN layer. Learned input/output projections, beta/gate parameter transforms, output gated norm, residual/hyperconnections, optimizer updates and packed-document resets are absent.
No MLX/Torch/Metal execution, quantized checkpoint payload, serving dtype/ABI parity, target-size or16K backward/memory/performance qualification.
The implementation components and active DeepSeek runtime were not changed by this reviewer; only review/probe artifacts were created.
next_milestone: Suitable as an independent tiny composed oracle to test later backend implementations and state-carry integration. Keep full-layer and target-dimension qualification separate.
